newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Solvay buys Bulgarian soda ash producer.
newsitem.headline: Solvay buys Bulgarian soda ash producer.

text.p: Belgian chemicals company Solvay SA said on Thursday it had signed a preliminary agreement with the Bulgarian privatisation agency allowing it to acquire 60 percent of soda ash producer SODI SPJS Co for $160 million.
Solvay said the acquisition would give it access to markets in the Balkans, the Middle East and Central Asia.

It said a capital investment programme was planned at SODI to raise dense soda ash capacity, to modernise the plant and to improve environmental performance, bringing technology to Bulgaria, a country of nine million inhabitants.
Brussels-based Solvay has a workforce of 38,000. Total sales in 1995 amounted to $9.3 billion.
